pages.en:
Re Indian marriage.
The former Miss Charlotte Wegzyn studied at the school
of Mr Damon typewriting and shorthand. She became employed at her husbands
office as shorthand typist in his office in the East Seward Road. When he
removed into town with his office his wife went with him and became later
his friend. The parents of the wife firstly opposed to the marriage but
agreed afterwards. The parents of the wife are occupied with the sale of
carpet mats and so on. The husband enjoys a very good reputation.

pages.zh:
关于印度人婚姻一事。
前韦格津（Wegzyn）小姐曾在达蒙（Damon）先生开办的学校学习打字和速记。她受雇于其丈夫位于东熙华德路（East Seward Road）的办公室，担任速记打字员。当其丈夫将办公室迁至市区时，其妻随行，并随后成为其友。女方父母起初反对这桩婚事，但后来同意了。女方父母从事地毯、席垫等物品的销售业务。男方声誉甚佳。

DR. FELIX KARDEGO
ATTORNEY-AT-LAW
XY
826 East Yuhang Rd.
ROOM 420 TEL. 13899

SHANGHAI, February 8th 1944.
（批：430）
（批：9-2-44）

-Re Indian Marriage.

The parents of the bride are Polish Refugees Siegmund and Finna
Wegrzyn. They have three children, the bride, Charlotte, 17 years,
and two boys, Jacques and Arno, 13 resp. 7 years old. They lived at
1166 Broadway East and removed after the proclamation to Ward Rd.
Mr. Wegrzyn is merchant with carpets and mats.
Further particulars will follow.

上海，1944年2月8日。
（批注：430）
（批注：1944年2月9日）

-关于印度人婚姻一事。

新娘的父母是波兰难民齐格蒙德（Siegmund）和芬娜·韦格津（Finna Wegrzyn）。他们有三名子女，即新娘夏洛特（Charlotte），17岁，以及两名男孩，雅克（Jacques）和阿诺（Arno），分别为13岁和7岁。他们原住在百老汇路（Broadway）东段1166号，在戒严令颁布后搬至华德路（Ward Rd.）。韦格津先生是经营地毯和席垫的商人。
更多详情将后续呈报。
